shared_elements: row of three arched or loop-shaped elements along the top edge
horizontal band filled with zigzag/triangle (chevron) pattern
quadruped animal in profile with open jaws facing left
small circle or disc held between figures
elongated reptile or lizard-like creature in profile
large bird-like head with long beak at lower left
herringbone/feathered lozenge motif in lower register
narrower shaft-like lower portion below a wider upper slab
justification: Every motif in A recurs in B in the same register order and the same relative position — the three arches over a chevron band, the left-facing open-jawed quadruped with the disc and crouching figure beside it, and the long-beaked head over the herringbone lozenge on the narrower lower shaft — a correspondence far too specific to be coincidental. The only real differences are conditions of presentation and surface: A is a lighter, sunlit block seen in situ among rubble, while B is a darker, mottled, more granular surface isolated on a plain ground with slightly different broken edges along the lower right.
